Lux Restaurant.name: Lux Restaurant
Lux Restaurant.longDescription: Take your taste buds on a journey through culinary cultures around the world. Lux Restaurant offers a diverse menu from authentic Asian flavors to classic European dishes. Located on the 2nd floor of the hotel, the restaurant’s luxurious space is where you can enjoy a lavish meal prepared by talented chefs while admiring the night view of the coastal city.

Maybar.longDescription: Enjoy the city view at night from May Bar, an amazing experience on the 21st floor of the hotel.

May Lounge.longDescription: May Lounge is designed in a modern and sophisticated style, perfectly combining luxury and coziness.
